paragraphs.text: Bartel Runeaxe was a legendary Giant warrior from Dominaria .

Bartel Runeaxe debuted as a character in Legends . He appears to be from the mountain stronghold of Hammerheim on Dominaria . He wielded a giant axe and it was said that no foe could slow his charge. He has an apparent immunity to Auras targeting him.
Bartel was originally printed with the Legend type but was given errata to be a Giant Warrior when Legend was made obsolete.
